synthetic_input: I am a volunteer at Cobalt Grove Community Garden. In a forum post I described my own weekly drip-irrigation checks: I put a measuring cup under each emitter for 30 seconds. Last week I found two clogged emitters and cleaned them with water. I did not measure plant health or compare irrigation products. This is one volunteer's observation, not an official recommendation.
